summary: The revision fixes F1-F4 and F8-F12 in substance. F5, F6, F7, and F9 are only partly fixed. The revision adds three Blockers: the print-audit input check has no size or schema source (F13), the pilot set has no identity or reseed rule (F14), and the quota no-value state differs between the spec and the plan test (F15). Four Major findings remain on bias, dates, the work-type threshold, and the manifest hash. Phase 1 has no open product decision, but the review verdict is fail.

paraphrase.proposes: The track adds track A, a seeded-defect code review benchmark. It takes diffs from two public repos by a fixed rule, plants defects with a private answer key, and scores each route by the worst of three passes. It adds page B from the sanitized weekly export, one print-audit block, and an overview table that says which model to use for each kind of work. It moves the replay track to the backlog and holds the first publish for Daniel's word.
paraphrase.current_system: Per the spec, the benchmark runs build, bugfix, tests, and change tracks through one hidden harness. The build scores are 88.9 to 95.0 and the tests scores are 79.4 to 98.8, so the tables do not separate the models. The site publishes the docs/ folder through a daily job that commits and pushes it. Page B uses a separate sanitized export of 1,798 role runs.

blocking_findings: F13 [Blocker] spec.md D17 and plan.md 2.4: The print-audit input check reads a size and a schema that the hand-off file and its MANIFEST do not hold. Rationale: the v13 JSON has no schema key, and its MANIFEST.txt holds the SHA-256 but no size; task 2.4 cannot pass the D17 check on the real file, so acceptance 6 and the 2026-11-18 preview are blocked.

F14 [Blocker] spec.md D13 and plan.md 4.11: The pilot set has no id, no selection rule, no seeding task, and no stated relation to the ranked set; a reseed has no new id. Rationale: D8 fixes the first set at 14 diffs and a change makes a new set id, while D13 adds a 6-diff pilot set; the implementer must choose which 6 diffs to seed and whether the pilot tests the ranked set, so two builds diverge and the gate can pass a set that is not ranked.

F15 [Blocker] spec.md D15 and FR-15; plan.md 4.2: A source with no value gives wait in the spec and stopped in the plan test. Rationale: D15 and FR-15 say a source with no value gives wait, while task 4.2 says a missing field and a non-number give stopped; the Red test and a Green built to the spec cannot both pass.
nonblocking_findings: F16 [Major] spec.md D5, D11, R3, and Q9: The second judge is a ranked family, the author and first judge stay Anthropic, and an unclear verdict removes the route's rank. Rationale: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is a D12 ranked route; the agreement rule blocks a single false claim but not style bias, and the no-rank rule makes a disagreement count against the model, contrary to OD5; use a judge family outside D12 (Qwen or Doubao), or give the judge's family no rank and keep the pass ranked with agreed verdicts only.

F17 [Major] spec.md D13 and R7; plan.md Phase 4: The pilot's two nights plus the three main passes do not fit before 2026-11-22 for the two pilot routes. Rationale: D15 allows one pass per route per night; with the set ready on 11-19, the pilot needs 11-19 and 11-20, leaving 11-21 and 11-22 for two main passes, so MiniMax and Kimi finish on 11-23; seed and run the pilot by 11-18, or let the pilot passes count, and add the allowed reason to acceptance 11.

F18 [Major] spec.md D16 and acceptance 5; plan.md 1.1: The work-type fewer-than-10-runs rule does not say whether it counts the export runs or the shown pass + fail. Rationale: 17 work-type rows have runs of 10 or more and pass + fail below 10, so the choice changes the few-runs mark and the overview pick; say fewer than 10 results (pass + fail) and state that the work-type row sums the role rows.

F19 [Major] spec.md D9 and D11; plan.md 3.15 and 4.13: The public manifest records the key SHA-256 before apply adds real_defects, so the published hash no longer matches the key. Rationale: FR-12 updates the key after the 3.15 manifest commit; the R8 integrity check then reports a changed key for a legitimate adjudication; rewrite and commit the manifest after the apply, or keep real_defects outside the hashed key.

F20 [Nit] spec.md OD6 and D17: The checklist item code and text is a list of 0 to 3 items in the file. Rationale: 43 rows hold 1 to 3 checklist items and 9 hold none; plan 2.1 already says items, so the spec should say the checklist items (0 to 3).

F21 [Nit] spec.md OD8 and R9: The region block is stated as present, but Daniel turned on Global regions at about 11:00 on 2026-11-14. Rationale: the rule is a useful guard; record that the switch is on, so the pilot route rule and the probe are read as guards, not as the current state.

F22 [Nit] plan.md 2.4, 2.6, and 4.8: Three Green tasks write two files, so the rule each Green task writes one tool or one page is not literal. Rationale: each pair is one page or data file plus its wiring; keep the small unit and say one tool or one page, plus its wiring.

F23 [Nit] plan.md 0.3: The verify line uses the CONTEST words withdrawn or kept for a revision round. Rationale: this round has no CONTEST item; the reviewer reports fixed, partly fixed, or not fixed, and the plan should use that vocabulary.
